mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals imminent monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE below 4.0%), tight labor markets drive wage inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index 2017=100) signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST above 1500.0) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 137000.0 (thousands) signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 137000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 203.0 (index 1982-1984=100) signals accelerating inflation that triggers a Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 203.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
